payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 3 requires that 'a head gate result that fails with no new failure ... [is] left out' of verify.json's `gates` list, but no test ever supplies a `GateResult` that is `status='fail'` yet contributes no `new_failures` identity. Both tests that exercise `write_verify_comparison` (`tests/test_cli.py::test_a_finish_writes_its_suite_comparison_beside_its_findings` and the earlier finishing-suite test) only use a `pass` result with no failures and `fail` results that each have a matching new failure, so replacing the identity-based filter `if any(identity(result.gate, failure) in new_identities for failure in result.failures)` with the simpler `if result.status == "fail"` keeps every existing test green while silently including pre-existing (baseline) failing gates in the recorded comparison, violating the stated criterion.
